purpose: Official native ManiSkill counterfactual replay of two equal physical observations with different valid saved previous controller target poses. Prove live target-state inversion yields equal commanded targets and achieved-pose-only command cannot, at one single step.
conditions: native action physical interval includes both required commands
three seeded-reset worlds have identical initial robot qpos/qvel and achieved EE pose
world B and blind C must use official controller.set_state API to shift saved target without moving physical qpos

arms.world_A: unshifted stored m_A and target-inverted physical command d-m_A
arms.world_B: different stored target m_B=m_A+(0.02,0,0), target-inverted command d-m_B
arms.world_C: same saved m_B as world B but blindly applies world-A action d-m_A (counterexample)

constraints: Controlled valid state replay via native controller.set_state, not claiming these are naturally reachable histories, physical robot safety or task-success improvement. The full simulator observation exposes target state; indistinguishability concerns source-policy observations with target-state slice withheld.
prior_experiment: Latent target minimax CPU model and 4 task running native audit are independent. This fresh controlled state-replay witness is not another 32-seed success evaluation.
